prompt:
Boss intro card art for the video game Enter the Gungeon: the boss "The Vet". The picture is the boss portrait that slides onto the vanilla boss intro card, like the Beholster in the first attached image.

Match the attached references exactly: the first image is the art style to copy (Enter the Gungeon boss card: bold dark outline, cel shading, chunky pixel art at card resolution). The second image is the in-game sprite sheet of The Vet: copy his exact look.

Subject: The Vet, a menacing veterinarian. Slicked dark brown quiff, round wire glasses with white glints, angry eyebrows, a toothy one-sided grin. Long white lab coat with lapels, a breast pocket with a red pen, teal-green scrubs underneath, a steel stethoscope around his neck, teal scrub trousers and dark shoes. In his right hand a big syringe pistol: glowing blue glass barrel with measure marks, a steel plunger ring, a long needle with a blue drop falling from the tip. In his left hand, raised beside his head, a steel scalpel.

Pose and composition: full body, three-quarter view, lunging toward the LEFT of the picture, aiming the syringe pistol to the left, coat tails flaring. The whole figure sits in the RIGHT 55 percent of a wide 16:9 frame and is closed by its own outline; nothing is cut by the frame edges. The LEFT 45 percent of the frame is completely empty plain background.

Rendering rules: crisp pixel art, bold near-black outline around the silhouette, 3 to 4 cel-shaded tones per material, light from the top-left, no gradients, no anti-aliasing, no text, no speed lines, no card frame. Plain flat pure green background (#00FF00) everywhere around the figure for easy removal.
